battle.name: 南康之戰
battle.brief: 開皇九年二月，隋軍已克建康、擒陳後主，然豫章太守徐璒仍據南康城抗隋，斷章江通道。柱國韋洸遣開府呂昂、長史馮世基兵臨城下，徐璒詐降而夜引所部二千人襲營，兩軍合擊，斬徐璒，隋軍入城。城頭秦弩本是守方壓制攻城者的利器，此役卻用在夜襲與反擊之間。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 此役是隋滅陳的收尾戰之一，交戰雙方是南陳的豫章守軍與隋朝南下安撫軍，背景則是嶺南數郡自成一體的割據局面。南陳方面，陳後主陳叔寶在建康被擒、陳國政權崩解之際，豫章太守徐璒仍據南康城自守，率領陳朝留置在江西的郡兵與城防部曲，憑章江天險拒絕受降；其指揮系統以太守為樞紐，屬下有郡丞、縣令與城防軍將，兵源包含本地郡兵與依附陳室的豪族部曲，守城則倚城頭弩機與城牆。隋朝方面，主帥是柱國韋洸，奉隋文帝詔命撫定嶺外，下轄開府呂昂、長史馮世基兩部兵馬相繼出發，隸屬平陳各軍的系統，由行軍總管一級調度，目標是打通江南通往嶺南的陸路與章江水路。嶺南方面，數郡共同奉高涼郡太夫人洗氏為主，號『聖母』，以高涼為中心集結各酋長與部落兵眾，自成一套以族首與洗氏幕府為樞紐的武裝體系，既不屬陳也未降隋，是此役三方角力中的第三支力量。
countriesEn: This engagement was one of the closing battles of the Sui conquest of Chen, fought between the Chen garrison of Yuzhang and the Sui army sent south to pacify the far south, against a background in which the southern counties of Lingnan had formed a bloc of their own. On the Chen side, at the moment when the Chen emperor Chen Shubao was captured at Jiankang and the Chen state collapsed, the Yuzhang governor Xu Jue still held the city of Nankang in defiance of the Sui, commanding the county troops and garrison detachments that Chen had left in Jiangxi and refusing to surrender on the strength of the position the city held on the Zhang River. His chain of command ran through the prefect: below him sat the assistant prefect, the county magistrates and the city garrison commanders, and his men were drawn from the local county levies and from the retainers of powerful families attached to the Chen court, while the defence of the walls rested on the crossbows mounted on the parapets. On the Sui side the commander was Wei Hui, a pillar of state, who received the edict of Sui Wen Emperor to pacify the region beyond the mountains. Under him the chief of the palace Lü Ang and the army recorder Feng Shiji led two contingents out in succession; they belonged to the general command structure of the war against Chen, were handled at the level of the roaming commander, and their aim was to open a land and river route from Jiangnan into Lingnan. On the Lingnan side, several counties together honoured the Lady of Gaoliang, the Widow of Xian, as their head, styling her the Holy Mother; around Gaoliang the local chiefs and tribal war bands were assembled into an armed system of its own whose pivot was the clan leaders together with the household administration of the Lady Xian. It owed allegiance neither to Chen nor to Sui, and it was the third force in the three-cornered struggle of this campaign.
people: 韋洸是此役的隋方主將，官柱國，奉詔撫定嶺外，是打通南康、進軍廣州一路的指揮者；他統兵進至南康即受阻，待徐璒平定後率軍入廣州說諭諸州，其後在番禺夷王仲宣之亂中中流矢而死，廣州道行軍由副將慕容三藏檢校。徐璒是陳朝豫章太守，是這場戰爭的實際對手，他憑南康城與章江險固不肯降，詐降之後乘夜率二千兵襲擊隋營，事敗被斬。開府呂昂與長史馮世基是先鋒兩軍的主將，也是當夜合力破敵者。洗夫人是嶺南實力最高的領袖，高涼郡太夫人，眾稱聖母，集合首領數千人之後派遣孫子馮魂率眾迎接隋軍，隨後受冊為宋康郡夫人，後來加封譙國夫人。馮魂是洗氏之孫，隋軍抵達時奉命出迎，後由韋洸上表奏請授儀同三司。陳叔寶在降隋之後奉晉王楊廣之命作手書勸諭洗氏歸順；隋文帝楊堅則下詔撫定嶺外並冊封洗氏，是背後推動此事的一手。
peopleEn: Wei Hui was the Sui commander of the campaign. He held the rank of pillar of state and received the edict to pacify the lands beyond the mountains; he directed the drive that opened the road through Nankang and advanced on Guangzhou. His advance was checked at Nankang, and only after Xu Jue had been dealt with did he lead his army into Guangzhou and win over the commanderies there; shortly afterwards he was struck by an arrow and died during the revolt of the barbarian king of Panyu, Zhong Xuan, and the command of the Guangzhou circuit passed to his deputy Murong Sanzang. Xu Jue, governor of Yuzhang under Chen, was the actual opponent in this war. Relying on the fortifications of Nankang and the natural barrier of the Zhang River he refused to surrender; after his feigned submission he led two thousand men out at night to strike the Sui camp, and he was killed when the plan failed. Lü Ang, chief of the palace, and Feng Shiji, the army recorder, commanded the two vanguard contingents and were the men who between them broke the night attack. The Lady Xian was the most powerful figure in Lingnan, the Widow of Gaoliang, known as the Holy Mother; after gathering several thousand of the local leaders she sent her grandson Feng Hun out with his men to meet the Sui troops, and she was later ennobled as Lady of Songkang Commandery and subsequently raised to Lady of Qiaoguo. Feng Hun was her grandson and was sent out to receive the Sui army when it arrived; Wei Hui afterwards memorialised the court and he was granted the rank of Palace Attendant of the Household. Chen Shubao, once the state had fallen, was employed by Prince Yang Guang to write by his own hand to persuade the Lady Xian to submit to Sui. Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, issued the edict to pacify the far south and conferred the titles upon her; he was the hand behind the whole affair.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩在此役的位置，是城頭與營壘之間的骨幹火力。弩靠弩機把拉力儲存起來，上弦待發，擊發迅疾，遠勝拉弓，攻守雙方都靠它把對方壓在射程之外。南康是章江上游的州城，城垣緊貼水面，牆頭布防必以弩為骨幹：守方可居高臨下攔截接近城牆的步卒，攻方則須先以拒馬、盾楯與器械抵近牆根，再由弩手在後列陣支援。城下的夜襲則是另一套配備，兩千人摸近營壘，靠的是短兵相接的刀盾而不是弩，弩在這種時刻反而要收起來，以免誤傷自己人。隋軍自建康一路南下，糧秣、柴薪與攻城器械靠水陸轉運，沿章江與大庾嶺一線的驛站和州縣接應，人馬補給線越過五嶺山道才能抵達南康城下，這條線的長度正是此役最實際的難處。嶺南方面，馮魂所部與洗氏首領多為輕裝步卒與馬隊，通鑑所記洗夫人披甲上馬、張錦傘、設彀騎衛，屬於護衛與儀仗兼用的配置。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card face occupies the position of the main volume of firepower between the parapet and the camp in this campaign. The crossbow stores the pull of the string in its trigger mechanism, is cocked and held ready, and releases far faster than a drawn bow, so both attackers and defenders used it to hold the other side beyond effective range. Nankang was a prefectural city on the upper Zhang River, its walls running close against the water, and the deployment on the parapet necessarily rested on the crossbow: the defenders could shoot down on infantry closing on the walls, while the attackers had to bring forward caltrops, shields and engines to the foot of the wall first, with crossbowmen drawn up in line behind them to support the assault. The night assault below the walls followed a different logic; the two thousand men who crept up to the camp relied on short-range blades and shields rather than on the crossbow, and in that hour the crossbows had to be put away so as not to shoot their own men. The Sui troops came south from Jiankang, and grain, fuel and siege equipment were shifted by water and by land, relayed along the Zhang River and the Dayuling range through the courier stations and the prefectures of the line. The supply route of men and horses had to cross the mountain tracks of the Five Ranges before it could reach the walls of Nankang, and the length of that line was the real difficulty of the campaign. In Lingnan the men of Feng Hun and the clansmen of the Lady Xian were mostly light infantry and mounted bands; the Zizhi Tongjian records the Lady Xian herself in armour and on horseback, with a silk parasol raised over her and a guard of archers drawn up about her, a formation that served as protection and ceremony at once.
tactics: 此役的戰術主軸是『詐降加夜襲』與『兩軍合擊』兩個動作。隋軍自建康出發，韋洸大軍駐紮南康外圍，開府呂昂、長史馮世基兩部先鋒相繼抵近城下；徐璒見大軍壓境，開門詐降以圖拖住隋軍，暗中整備所部二千人，待夜半分批出營，直取先到的呂昂軍營，企圖趁隋軍新到疲憊、陣腳未穩之際一舉擊潰，再退守城池。徐璒低估的是隋軍的應變速度與兩路兵之間的呼應：呂昂軍遇襲時並不專心追擊逃散之敵，而是緊守營陣、就近結陣，等待馮世基軍合擊，兩軍夾擊之下，襲營部隊被截為數段，首領徐璒當場被斬，南康城隨即易手。隋軍入城之後並未對廣州方向大舉用兵，韋洸改以說諭為主：先以詔書與陳叔寶手書宣示國已亡、舊主已降，再由洗氏遣馮魂率眾出迎，各州首領見高涼勢力已倒向隋廷，遂陸續歸順。補給與接應方面，隋軍主力停在南康作中繼站，嶺外消息與糧秣靠船隊經章江、珠江水系轉輸，避免了士卒長途穿越五嶺的消耗。
tacticsEn: The tactical axis of this engagement was a pair of movements: a feigned surrender combined with a night attack, and a two-arm pincer by the Sui. The Sui marched out of Jiankang, the main body of Wei Hui encamped outside Nankang, and the vanguards under Lü Ang and Feng Shiji arrived at the walls in turn. Seeing the main host close in, Xu Jue opened the gates and pretended to surrender, buying time and holding the Sui army in place while he secretly drilled his two thousand men; in the night he sent them out in several parties to strike the camp of Lü Ang, which had arrived first, hoping to break the Sui in one blow while they were exhausted from the march and had not yet settled into formation, then fall back into the city. What Xu Jue underestimated was the speed of the Sui reaction and the coordination between the two columns. Under attack, Lü Ang's men did not chase the scattered enemy but held their camp, closed ranks on the spot, and waited for Feng Shiji's column to come up. Caught between the two, the assaulting force was cut into several segments and its leader Xu Jue was killed on the spot, and the city of Nankang changed hands immediately. After entering the city the Sui did not march in force toward Guangzhou; Wei Hui switched to persuasion. He first put forward the edict together with the letter written by Chen Shubao to announce that the state had fallen and the former ruler had surrendered, and then the Lady Xian sent Feng Hun out with his men to receive the Sui troops. Seeing that the power of Gaoliang had already turned towards the Sui court, the chiefs of the commanderies submitted one after another. As for supply and support, the main Sui body stayed at Nankang as a relay station, and news and provisions for the far south were carried by the river fleet through the Zhang River and the Pearl River system, sparing the soldiers the exhaustion of a long march across the Five Ranges.
data: 可核對的數字集中在兵力與行政規模兩端。隋方，隋文帝事後自言『韋洸將二萬兵不能早度嶺』，可見安撫嶺外的大軍約二萬人；主帥韋洸之下，開府呂昂、長史馮世基各領一軍先期南下，裴矩後來接手嶺南時，通鑑記其『以三千弊卒徑至南海』，兩相比照可知韋洸一軍規模遠大而推進遲緩。陳方夜襲兵力為徐璒所部二千人，發生在一夜之內。嶺南一側，洗夫人一度集結首領數千人，遣馮魂率眾迎隋軍，後來她隨裴矩巡撫二十餘州，並奉敕開幕府、聽發部落六州兵馬。行政統計上，陳國覆亡後隋朝所得為州三十、郡一百、縣四百；此役之後嶺南二十四州悉歸王化，韋洸入廣州說諭諸州皆定。時間線上，開皇九年二月建康既下、陳後主被擒，嶺南未附，二月之內詔遣韋洸撫嶺外，二月末至三月初南康事平，三月己巳陳叔寶與王公百司自建康起程赴長安，四月辛亥隋文帝幸驪山，乙巳諸軍凱入京師獻俘。地理上，自建康至南康逾千里，隋軍捨海路由陸路與章江水路南下，故有『不能早度嶺』之嘆。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster at the two ends of the scale: troop strength and the size of the administration. On the Sui side the emperor was later heard to say that Wei Hui had twenty thousand men and still could not cross the mountains early, so the force sent to pacify the far south amounted to some twenty thousand. Under Wei Hui, Lü Ang with the rank of chief of the palace and Feng Shiji the army recorder each led a contingent ahead of the main body, and when Pei Ju took over the Lingnan command later, the Zizhi Tongjian records that he went straight to the South Sea with three thousand troops in poor condition; set against each other, the two figures show how much larger the army of Wei Hui was and how much slower it moved. On the Chen side the night attack was made by two thousand of Xu Jue's men, all within the space of a single night. On the Lingnan side the Lady Xian once assembled several thousand of the local leaders and sent Feng Hun out with his men to meet the Sui troops; later she toured more than twenty commanderies with Pei Ju, and by imperial decree she was given a household administration of her own, with authority to call up the troops of the tribal areas of six commanderies. On the administrative side, once the Chen state had been overthrown the Sui counted its acquisitions as thirty prefectures, one hundred commanderies and four hundred counties; after this engagement the twenty-four commanderies of Lingnan were wholly brought under the imperial order, Wei Hui reached Guangzhou and every commandery there came over by persuasion. As to the chronology: in the second month of the ninth year of Kaihuang Jiankang fell and Chen Shubao was taken; Lingnan was still unsubdued; within that same second month the edict went out sending Wei Hui to pacify the far south; between the end of the second month and the beginning of the third the matter of Nankang was settled; on the ji-si day of the third month Chen Shubao and the hundred officials of the Chen court set out from Jiankang for Chang'an; in the fourth month, on the xin-hai day, the Sui emperor went out to Lishan, and on the yi-si day the armies returned in triumph and offered their captives at the ancestral temple. In geography, the distance from Jiankang to Nankang exceeds a thousand li, and the Sui took the road by land and the water of the Zhang River rather than the sea, which is precisely why there was lament that the army could not cross the mountains early.
cause: 起事與抗爭的直接原因，是陳朝覆亡與隋朝軍隊南下之間的落差。開皇九年正月，隋軍自長江兩路渡江，二月克建康、擒陳後主，江北與建康一帶的陳軍主力隨即瓦解；但江西不像建康一帶被一鍋端起，豫章一帶的郡兵仍奉陳室舊吏，據城自守，陳的政令中斷之後，地方守將的第一反應不是立刻放下兵器，而是先確認新主軍的態度與自身的去留。嶺南方面更形複雜：陳朝在嶺外只有影響力而無直轄郡縣，陳亡之後各郡自行推舉領袖，奉洗氏為主、號聖母，先採保境自守而非抵抗的姿態，這既為陳室留下了苟延的空間，也讓隋廷無法用一句詔書解決問題。隋文帝於是下詔遣柱國韋洸等安撫嶺外，目標是先以武力打通自江南入嶺南的通道，再以招撫收編各州；徐璒據南康抗命，正是因為南康扼住章江上游，是江南入廣州的門戶，控制了此城即控制了嶺北的通道，隋軍要進廣州，就必須先拿下他。晉王楊廣另遣陳叔寶作手書勸諭洗氏，用的是陳室正統仍存的象徵權威，想令嶺南不戰而降。
causeEn: The immediate cause of the resistance was the gap between the fall of the Chen state and the arrival of the Sui armies. In the first month of the ninth year of Kaihuang the Sui crossed the Yangtze in two columns; in the second month they took Jiankang and seized Chen Shubao, and the main body of the Chen forces north of the river and around the capital collapsed with it. But Jiangxi was not extinguished in a single stroke the way the area around Jiankang was, and the county troops of the Yuzhang region still obeyed the old retainers of the Chen house and held their cities. Once the Chen government's orders had ceased to run, the first reaction of a local commander was not to lay down his arms at once, but to find out what the new masters intended and what would become of him. Lingnan was more complicated still. The Chen court had influence beyond the mountains but no directly administered commanderies there, and after its fall each commandery put forward a leader of its own, honouring the Lady Xian as head and styling her the Holy Mother. Their first posture was to hold their own ground rather than to resist, which left the Chen house a little room to prolong itself and left the Sui court unable to settle the matter with a single edict. Emperor Wen of Sui therefore issued the edict sending Wei Hui and others to pacify the far south, with the object of opening by force a route from Jiangnan into Lingnan and then taking the commanderies over by amnesty and persuasion. Xu Jue's refusal to yield at Nankang was not obstinacy alone: Nankang commanded the upper course of the Zhang River and was the gateway from Jiangnan to Guangzhou, so holding the city meant holding the northern approach, and the Sui army could not reach Guangzhou without first taking it. Prince Yang Guang at the same time employed Chen Shubao to write by his own hand to the Lady Xian, using the symbolic authority of the still-living Chen orthodoxy in the hope that Lingnan would submit without a fight.
impact: 此役的直接影響，是打通了隋朝經營嶺南的通道，也讓隋朝在統一之後立刻找到了一個可行的治理辦法。南康既下，韋洸得以率軍直抵廣州，嶺南二十四州隨之歸順，陳朝留下的江南與嶺外版圖就此合入隋朝，隋文帝至此完成南北一統。更深一層的影響來自制度：洗氏因助隋平定嶺南而受封，後來奉敕開設譙國夫人幕府，置長史以下官屬，官給印信，可以直接發動部落六州兵馬，遇機急還得便宜行事，並親自撫巡二十餘州、招撫逃亡的俚獠。洗氏在梁、陳、隋三朝之間只效忠不反的態度，加上幕府制度的建立，開了後世羈縻體系以藩鎮首長領軍、以長史參贊政務的先例。豫章一帶因為歸順而與長江流域連成一體，隋朝在江南的行政推進再無阻滯。另一層影響是軍官更替：韋洸在此役之後不久即戰歿，廣州道行軍由慕容三藏接替，說明隋廷對嶺南的經營是分階段交給不同將領的，韋洸是開路者而不是終結者。
impactEn: The direct effect of this engagement was that the corridor by which the Sui would administer Lingnan was opened, and that the dynasty, having just achieved unification, immediately found a workable way of governing. With Nankang taken, Wei Hui was able to lead his troops straight to Guangzhou, and the twenty-four commanderies of Lingnan submitted in their wake; the territories of Jiangnan and the country beyond the mountains that Chen had left behind were thus folded into the Sui, and Emperor Wen completed the union of north and south. The deeper effect was institutional. The Lady Xian was ennobled for having helped the Sui bring Lingnan to order, and was later granted by decree the household administration of the Lady of Qiaoguo, with a recorder and other officers below her, an official seal in her keeping, the right to call up the troops of the tribal areas of six commanderies and, in an emergency, to act on her own judgement; she also toured more than twenty commanderies in person to bring back those who had fled. Her posture of serving loyally and never rebelling across the reigns of Liang, Chen and Sui, together with the creation of this household administration, set the precedent for the later system of tribal commanderies, in which a feudatory head raised troops while a recorder took part in the administration. With Yuzhang surrendered, that region was joined to the Yangtze valley and the Sui advance through Jiangnan met no further obstacle. A further effect was the change of commanders: Wei Hui died in battle shortly after this campaign and the command of the Guangzhou circuit passed to Murong Sanzang, which shows that the Sui court entrusted the business of Lingnan in stages to different generals, and that Wei Hui was the man who opened the road rather than the one who closed the matter.
result: 結果是隋軍完全控制南康，徐璒被斬，豫章諸郡隨之歸順，嶺南大局底定。作戰層面上，這是一場以夜襲開始、以合擊收尾的短促交鋒：徐璒詐降不成，二千人的夜襲部隊在呂昂與馮世基兩軍配合下被吃掉，首領被斬，南康城門在隋軍面前打開。政治層面上，韋洸入廣州，說諭嶺南諸州皆定，洗氏遣孫馮魂率眾出迎，韋洸上表請授馮魂儀同三司，隋文帝則冊洗氏為宋康郡夫人，表彰她沒有隨陳室沉淪反而助隋平粵。陳朝覆亡的結局就此完成：隋朝取得陳地州三十、郡一百、縣四百，陳叔寶與王公百司於三月己巳自建康起程，經五百里不絕於途的隊伍押赴長安，四月辛亥隋文帝幸驪山，乙巳諸軍凱入太廟獻俘。整場戰爭並非以大血戰收場，而是以城破、頭銜與冊封的交換收場，標誌著南朝最後一個反覆據守的據點被清除，也標誌著長江以南的舊秩序被徹底替換。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Sui held Nankang completely, Xu Jue was killed, the commanderies of Yuzhang submitted in their wake, and the situation in Lingnan was settled. At the level of operations this was a short and sharp engagement that began with a night attack and ended with a pincer: Xu Jue's feigned surrender miscarried, his two thousand night attackers were destroyed by the combined action of Lü Ang and Feng Shiji, their leader was killed, and the gates of Nankang opened to the Sui. At the level of politics, Wei Hui reached Guangzhou and won over every commandery of Lingnan by persuasion; the Lady Xian sent her grandson Feng Hun out with his men to receive the Sui troops, Wei Hui memorialised the court and Feng Hun was granted the rank of Palace Attendant of the Household, and Emperor Wen of Sui ennobled the Lady Xian as Lady of Songkang Commandery, in recognition of the fact that she had not gone down with the Chen house but had helped the Sui bring the south to order. The conclusion of the Chen state was thereby completed: the Sui took over thirty prefectures, one hundred commanderies and four hundred counties of Chen territory; on the ji-si day of the third month Chen Shubao and the hundred officials of his court set out from Jiankang, their column unbroken for five hundred li on the road, to be brought to Chang'an; in the fourth month, on the xin-hai day, the Sui emperor went out to Lishan, and on the yi-si day the victorious armies entered the capital and offered their captives at the ancestral temple. The war was not closed by a great pitched battle, but by an exchange of the city, of ranks and of titles; it marked the clearing away of the last strongpoint where the southern court had held out in stubborn resistance, and the complete replacement of the old order south of the Yangtze.
